title: Democratic Quality Scorecard: Citizen Algorithmic Rights Biometric and AI Transparency Bill

dimensions.evidence: Protects Article 21 privacy rights and Article 14 non-discrimination against AI bias.
Prohibits biometric exclusion in welfare delivery for marginalized populations.
Independent Algorithmic Rights Commission with cease-and-desist power.
dimensions.corrective_action: Severe criminal fines for illegal surveillance.

dimensions.evidence: Commission independent of executive intelligence agencies.
Mandatory open-source AI impact audits and public source code disclosure.
dimensions.corrective_action: Statutory override for public sector software.

dimensions.evidence: Cease-and-desist orders; statutory right to human explainability and override.
60-day consultation with tech ethicists and civil society.
